verdict.rationale: Paperspace docs show NVIDIA H100 machines, though they require an approval request. Ampere A100s (up to 8 GPUs) serve as an older option, and the vendor claims a broad GPU catalog with easy switching between instance types for cost/performance trade-offs. Missing for 10: any evidence of H200 or B200 availability, a documented list of cheaper previous-generation GPU types and pricing, and independent confirmation of current-gen capacity without approval gating.
